collector_scope: Executed on installed environment; CPU node/model method wall intervals and device-wide GPU samples, not CUDA kernel or exclusive-process measurements.
parameters_policy: Freeze exact selected-image identities, existing quality request parameters and native16 full-frame budgets; no fast mode or frame reduction.

fixtures.child_input_policy: Exact retained last-frame PNG of the accepted parent; record its SHA after each parent trial, never substitute initial selected image.

warm_definition: A dedicated diagnostic harness must own one Comfy process for the three fixed-graph repeats, within a bounded experiment phase. Record actual model load/cache events; process warmth does not prove model residency. Production per-stage shutdown remains unchanged. If baseline lifecycle forces a fresh process, label it process_cold/disk_warm and do not count it as a model-warm trial. Harness/node instrumentation must be completed before GPU execution.

timing.start: Selected image acceptance complete, before local admission/preparation
timing.end: Local 1080p candidate passes delivery checks; publishing excluded
timing.human_wait: Recorded tool-question/user-response intervals; take union within each completion envelope and retain concurrent computation/scheduling; never infer GPU time by subtraction.
timing.baseline: Use unprofiled wall clock for performance; targeted tracing is a separate diagnostic run

required_evidence: model/workflow/mapping SHA and frozen request/graph identity
GPU utilization samples and sampled VRAM peak
human quality verdict and failure/redo reasons
unverified: Uninterrupted full-film production throughput and acceleration attribution (LVA-06 scope)
existing_runs_policy: Read only; no paused production resume, lock removal, paid calls, or unknown request resubmission
authorization_evidence: 2026-11-15 user: 同意，按这个做吧 — confirms selection proposals/new experiment GPU cold1/warm3 and later human video review; does not constitute quality acceptance.
cache_policy: New diagnostic process only: KSamplerAdvanced IS_CHANGED returns NaN so identical seeded samples execute; original model/text/input caching retained; original workflow bytes and all quality parameters unchanged. Warm means process warm, with actual model-load behavior reported independently.
